definitions.gloss: to serve, to work for (a master or lord)
definitions.explanation: To serve or attend to a person of higher status, such as a lord, ruler, or employer. Often used in historical or literary contexts.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{長年|ながねん}この{家|いえ}に{仕|つか}えてきた。
examples.english: He has served this household for many years.

examples.japanese: {武士|ぶし}は{主君|しゅくん}に{忠実|ちゅうじつ}に{仕|つか}えることを{誇|ほこ}りとした。
examples.english: Samurai took pride in serving their lord faithfully.

notes:
An ichidan verb. Frequently encountered in historical narratives and period dramas. The particle に marks the person being served. In modern usage, this word has a somewhat formal or literary flavor compared to the more neutral 働く (to work).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{神|かみ}に{仕|つか}える (serve God)
・{主君|しゅくん}に{仕|つか}える (serve one's lord)
・{国|くに}に{仕|つか}える (serve one's country)
・{宮廷|きゅうてい}に{仕|つか}える (serve at court)
